node_types.documentation: Brighten the picture by glow and push it toward orange by warmth.

Converts each Channels block on `channels` into one Records message on `records` holding the block's last sample of each channel as a float, keyed by that channel's name in `channel_names`: latest-value control, such as a sensor's reading or a fader's position, read by a node that takes Records. A block whose channel count is not the number of names is refused and writes nothing; a block of no samples writes nothing.

inputs.name: channels
inputs.documentation: The Channels blocks whose latest values are read

inputs.name: channel_names
inputs.documentation: The key each channel's value is written under, in the block's channel order.

outputs.name: records
outputs.documentation: One record per block: each channel's last sample under its name
